scope: workspace summary, learning due queue, job save actions, and settings presentation

baseline.finding: Three summary elements and three virtual-folder elements were links, while their primary card rules targeted article elements.
The queue had a generic grid rule but no dedicated button-row, title wrapping, source label, or action layout.
Read-only profile values and notification preferences were represented as disabled form controls.
The compact action rail used a 34px control height and an 88px minimum width.

structuralComparison.metric: job action control minimum height px

desktop1440x900: Workspace summary uses one feature column and three bounded summary columns.
Settings uses a two-column profile and side-stack layout.
Job actions use a consistent 132px rail with 40px minimum controls.
Learning due items render as separate full-width action rows.
mobile375x812: Workspace feature spans the full first row and three summaries remain in a bounded three-column row.
Settings and profile label/value pairs reflow to one column.
Virtual folders and job actions reflow to one column.
Learning due action rows stack title and action without joining adjacent titles.

behaviorRegression: Workspace summary and virtual-folder links remain navigable.
Each due review is a separate button and opens its learning unit.
Settings starts as semantic read-only content, enters an explicit edit state, saves changes, and returns to read-only content.
Folder save behavior and job bookmark behavior are unchanged.
limitations: No subjective visual-improvement percentage is claimed.
The responsive evidence is a deterministic source and behavior contract, not a newly captured browser screenshot.
User-supplied screenshots were used only as the task baseline and were not copied into repository evidence because they contained personal information.
